algorithm: Advisory cosine overlap with corpus-local IDF over complete current units; query is latest supplied user_message plus active provenance_kind=user fact values only. Ignore numeric tokens and generic language stopwords. No source IDs, URLs, case IDs, or oracle fields influence score. Stable ties follow current source/unit positions.
shortlist: Up to two substantive positive-overlap units by default, within 6000 raw passage UTF8 bytes; skip whole oversized units, never truncate. Explicit historical/other USER-version records are omitted from this current-environment advisory list, not from original evidence. No source diversity rule: two complementary chunks of one source may both be suggested.
scope: Pure analyst/caller helper. No automatic decision changes, source acceptance, citations, model messages, retrieval ranking, factories, or execution authority. Lexical signals are not relevance/entailment labels; missing signals are not proof of missing evidence. Source text can adversarially match query terms.
comparison: Original retained selections, authored projection into complete sections, and independent advisory shortlist are separate observations. Original model choices are not rewritten or reclassified. Full evidence remains available.
